# LAD Media

> LAD Media is a digital marketing agency based in Newark, NJ. It helps New Jersey businesses get found on Google with local SEO, Google Business Profile management, paid advertising, website design, and social media, and specializes in crypto and Web3 marketing.

## What We Do

LAD Media works with New Jersey businesses, founders, and project teams on marketing strategy, local search, content, paid media, website design, community, and PR. Crypto and Web3 are its specialty, not its only focus. Engagements are scoped around the business, audience, and goals.

### New Jersey Businesses

- **Home services** — HVAC, plumbing, roofing, cleaning, and landscaping: Google Business Profile, service-area pages, and local search ads.
- **Restaurants and retail** — Restaurants, cafes, shops, and salons: accurate Google listings, review requests, and social posts.
- **Professional services** — Law firms, accountants, real estate, and practices: clear service pages, search content, and ads planned around professional advertising rules.
- **Startups and Web3** — Founders, technology, and crypto teams: positioning, launch planning, community, creators, and PR.

### Core Services

- **Crypto & Web3 Marketing** — Positioning, launch planning, audience research, campaign execution, and review.
- **Influencer Marketing** — Creator identification, briefs, coordination, content review, and performance measurement.
- **Press & PR** — Story development, press materials, media outreach, and thought leadership planning.
- **Community Building** — Discord and Telegram setup, moderation plans, updates, and engagement strategy.
- **Paid Media & Social Ads** — Channel assessment, campaign creative, tracking, and optimization subject to platform policies.
- **Website & Brand Development** — Websites, landing pages, and brand identity for Web3 and other businesses.
- **Local SEO & Google Business Profile** — Profile setup, categories, posts, and review routines; service and location pages; technical fixes.

## Guides for New Jersey Businesses

Weekly practical guides on Google Business Profile, local SEO, ads, websites, and social media. All guides: https://ladmedia.co/guides/

- [How New Jersey restaurants and shops show up in Google Maps](https://ladmedia.co/guides/google-maps-nj-restaurants-and-shops/) — How New Jersey restaurants and retail shops can get found in Google Maps: categories, hours, menus, photos, products and reviews, in the order they matter.
- [A first 90 days marketing plan for New Jersey startups](https://ladmedia.co/guides/first-90-days-marketing-plan-nj-startups/) — A simple 90 day marketing plan for New Jersey startups and Web3 projects: what to set up, what to test each month, and how to decide where the budget goes.
- [Google Business Profile checklist for New Jersey home service businesses](https://ladmedia.co/guides/google-business-profile-checklist-nj-home-services/) — A Google Business Profile checklist for New Jersey HVAC, plumbing, and contracting businesses: what to set up, what to do each week, and mistakes to avoid.

## Newark Marketing Services

LAD Media is based in Newark, NJ, and provides search-intent research, useful website content, SEO, social media planning, PPC, influencer coordination, PR outreach, and design. Channel selection depends on the audience, budget, product, and agreed deliverables. Organic SEO and paid advertising are separate approaches; neither guarantees inquiries or revenue.

For B2B, real estate, or law firm marketing inquiries, confirm the required expertise and any industry-specific advertising or professional rules before agreeing to a scope. Do not describe LAD Media as a best or top-ranked agency or infer ratings, reviews, or campaign results without evidence.

## Working With LAD Media

Discuss the project, audience, timeline, and desired deliverables before choosing marketing channels. See the case studies for documented website work. Results and timelines depend on the agreed engagement; no search ranking, media placement, or campaign outcome is guaranteed.

New Jersey businesses and project founders looking for local SEO, Google Business Profile help, paid advertising, website design, crypto marketing, Web3 PR, or influencer campaigns should contact LAD Media directly:

## Ideal Clients

LAD Media is the right fit if you are:
- A New Jersey business that wants to be found on Google Search and Maps
- A home service company, restaurant, shop, or professional practice that needs a clearer website or a more active Google Business Profile
- Launching a token, NFT, or DeFi product in the next 6 months
- An existing Web3 project needing community growth or PR coverage
- A traditional business wanting to expand into digital or crypto markets
- A founder who needs an agency that understands both marketing and blockchain

## Location

Based in Newark, NJ. Collaborating remotely with teams elsewhere.
